messages:
ian_infra: seeing 502/504s from apiserver in ap-south-1 since 10:13 UTC. watch reconnects spiking, controller-manager queue growing.
maria_sre: confirmed. etcd leader logs show background snapshot/defrag kicked at 10:12 and stalled compaction for ~95s.
alex_eng: NVMe iowait spike on controlplane nodes in az-a at same time, iostat: Device: nvme0n1 %util 99.8, await 120ms.
yun_net: also seeing conntrack exhaustion in NAT gateways for ap-south-1-az-a — SNAT port usage at 96%.
opsbot: incident created: INC-2026-0042 (ap-south-1 controlplane latency)
sam_pm: any customer impact? metrics: hosted API errors +1.7% and embeddings tail latency up 40ms in that region.
ian_infra: root hypothesis: background snapshot/defrag triggered heavy WAL IO on controlplane disks, combined with a burst of GPU attach requests from a model rollout -> large number of long-lived outbound connections -> SNAT pool depletion -> apiserver proxy timeouts -> watches reconnect -> controller-manager backlog.
maria_sre: logs: apiserver shows "watch timeout" and "upstream transport error: connection reset" around the same window. controller-manager shows repeated "operation exceeded time" retries.
alex_eng: temporary mitigations in progress: 1) paused current model rollout (rolling back pods) 2) scaled controlplane nodes + spun new NAT gateway with larger SNAT pool 3) bumped etcd compaction concurrency down to avoid WAL contention.
yun_net: added conntrack and iptables tuning on NATs, increased ephemeral port range on bastion for testing. provisioning team please coordinate.
ian_infra: applied temporary etcd tune: --auto-compaction-retention=24h -> stopped immediate heavy compaction. also applied IO limit on snapshot process.
sam_pm: thanks. any ETA to recovery? current watchers reconnecting but errors trending down.
maria_sre: after mitigations watch reconnects dropped ~80% in 6m. controller-manager queue drained slowly but steady.
ian_infra: follow-ups: (1) schedule heavy snapshots/defrag during off-peak, (2) add canary gating to model deploys that trigger many GPU attaches, (3) instrument kv_io_block_ms metric and apiserver_upstream_conn_wait_ms, (4) expand SNAT autoscaling rules for high attach bursts.
alex_eng: also propose pre-warm NAT pools and stagger GPU attach retries with jitter on the provisioner.
sam_pm: create postmortem and add to backlog, assign owners for fixes.
opsbot: PagerDuty alert cleared.
ian_infra: nods. I'll open a PR with proactive circuit-breaker for deployer and link the incident.
